result.summary: No blocking defect. Static review only; runtime claims rest on hosted CI and the TEST-DESIGNER tests still to be written. VERIFIED: (1) PUT authority: the PUT goes through Scope.require_interactive_tenant_admin/1 = credential == :oidc (a token of any role set, including an owner who is a tenant-wide admin, is refused; absent credential refused), then require_tenant_wide(:UsersGroupsRolesManage), then :TENANT_ADMIN in principal.roles AND effective_scope(principal, TENANT_ADMIN) == :tenant_wide. effective_roles strips PLATFORM_ADMIN outside the platform tenant and effective_scope has no PLATFORM_ADMIN shortcut, so a platform-tenant PLATFORM_ADMIN without TENANT_ADMIN, a scoped-only admin (node rows), a group with zero rows (:deny) and a non-Grants struct (:deny) all fall to the one uniform 403 (same body, no existence info). The helper is the old private pair from Routers.Identity moved in the same order (oidc, tenant-wide, role, effective scope); the service-principal route behaviour is unchanged (same 403 via forbid_insufficient). (2) Transitions in do_flip under locks A, T (S taken inside the gate step) in one Repo.transaction with the single rescue around the whole transaction: same mode no-op first; target :on from anything but :shadow rolls back :shadow_required before any fact is read; shadow->on runs OnGate (tagged {:on_gate, report}); off->shadow keeps enable_checks! (tagged {:three_facts, r}); on->shadow runs NO precondition and rolls back :reason_required when the reason is nil (422), so a failing fact or a scoped-out admin cannot block de-escalation, and it is reachable only through the same interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN PUT; ->off unchanged (check_reason(:off, nil) pre-transaction, so same-mode off without reason stays 422). Audit action by rank off<shadow<on. (3) on reachability: grep of lib/ priv/ config/ finds exactly ONE writer of tenants.scope_enforcement: Tenant.scope_enforcement_changeset/2 called only from ScopeEnforcement.do_flip (the other Tenant changesets cast slug, display_name, status, idp_realm_id, settings, login_disclosure_mode only). The DB CHECK widening (20261018200001) sets no row; the original migration defaults to off; no seed, mix task, TenantProvisioning, config or lib fixture sets on; test/support fixtures set it in tests only. (4) Gate not bypassable by request input: the router builds a literal three-key attrs map (actor_id, reason, trace_id); attrs[:now] is honoured only as a %DateTime{} via clock/1 and the router never sets it; thresholds are Application env from config.exs only (shadow_window.ex diff is moduledoc only). (5) 409 bodies: shadow_required carries the constant current_mode off; enforcement_precondition_failed carries failed codes, the counts, and evidence counts/booleans/dates; no ids, names or token data; OnGate.counts_state/evidence_state are the one shared serialisation (audit, 409, integrity). RefusedAudit runs after Repo.transaction returned, so after the rollback; a server fault is {:transaction_failed,_} and is never recorded as a refusal. (6) GET /integrity gains a rescue with one constant log line scope_enforcement_integrity_failed exception=<module> and a detail-free 500 (closes 2f-a F-2). (7) Under stored on, Authorize calls Enforce.check; admin-plane and default-class routes require Scope.allowed?(principal, permission, :tenant_wide). Platform-scope permissions are decided by role plus platform_tenant? only (Scope.allowed? platform clause), so a platform tenant stored on does not lock out PLATFORM_ADMIN on platform routes (INV-10). An interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN passes the admin plane (turn-off path); a scoped-only admin is denied. Route classes: no route_scope.ex, route snapshot, route_inventory.ex, authorized_router.ex, ci.yml, mix.exs, permission matrix or config change in git status, so the 115-route census and the 3 :self_service rulings are unchanged and this diff adds no exposure. (8) docs/roles.md: the AC 12 sentence is present verbatim (matches ShadowWindow scope_sentence), on-in-production items 1-8, known limitations incl. the scoped upsert_by external_ref refusal in import_scope_check/6, gate codes, transition table. (9) AC 24: no code path or data sets any tenant to on. The 3 stale on tenants ELIXIR-DEV saw in the shared LOCAL test DB (req519-n5-mix*) are test residue; no lib path can leave a tenant on outside a flip through the guarded PUT.

findings.title: Post-on lockout is possible: the last-admin guard counts token owners, the flip route needs an interactive admin, and there is no break-glass
findings.detail: The on gate requires at least one interactive explicit tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN at flip time (C-4), but TenantAdminGuard.ensure_admins_remain! still counts with count_tenant_wide_admins (token owners and flagged principals included). After on, the last interactive admin can be demoted or deactivated while a token-owner admin remains, leaving a tenant stored on that nobody can switch off through the API (tokens cannot PUT; no platform-scope flip route; docs item 7 states no break-glass). Accepted for pilot tenants and documented, but a real operational trap. Follow-up: make the guard use the interactive count for tenants stored on, or build the platform-scope flip route. File before pilot use; not a merge blocker.

pr_body_items.on_in_production_statement: A tenant that passes the six-fact gate can be set to on by an interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN, only from shadow, with an audit trail. In production today on delivers admin-plane closure to scoped admins, a uniform 403 for scoped users on every tenant-wide route, no new tenant-wide grants from binding writers or IdP sync, and fail-closed grant tables. It does NOT deliver data-level scoping (no installed module declares scope; no writer sets tasks.scope_node_id). The shadow period proves only the denials of tenant-wide and admin-plane routes. Scoped users lose definition, entity-definition, instance and service reads until RA-6 (REQ-525..527). Do not scope the CANDIDATE binding. Turning on off needs an interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN with a reason; no break-glass in this release. Pilot tenants only. No tenant is set to on by this PR (AC 24).
behaviour_changes: PUT /tenant/scope-enforcement is now interactive (OIDC) tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN only for EVERY transition: API tokens (any role set) and a platform-tenant PLATFORM_ADMIN without TENANT_ADMIN lose it, off->shadow included.
GET /tenant/scope-enforcement available_modes is now [off, shadow, on].
on->shadow no longer runs enable_checks! and is audited as scope.enforcement_disabled (rank rule off<shadow<on); a reason is mandatory.
New refusals: 409 shadow_required (off->on) and 409 enforcement_precondition_failed with gate codes, counts and evidence for shadow->on.
GET /tenant/scope-enforcement/integrity 500 path logs the constant line scope_enforcement_integrity_failed (exception module only).
PUT /users/:id/service-principal: no behaviour change (the same checks now live in Api.Scope.require_interactive_tenant_admin/1, same order, same 403).
